name: Decision Log
description: A minimal, audit-ready record of decisions made: what was decided, options considered, rationale, owner, and reversibility.

sections.title: Decisions Made
sections.instruction: For EACH decision, state it as a full sentence in the present tense ('We adopt X', 'We stop doing Y'). Always add reference transcript segment and timestamp.
sections.item_format:
| Decision | Made By | Reference Transcript Segment | Segment Time stamp |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

sections.title: Options Considered
sections.instruction: For each major decision, list the alternatives discussed and why they were not chosen.

sections.title: Rationale
sections.instruction: The reasoning, data, or constraints that drove each decision. Capture the 'why', not just the 'what'.

sections.title: Risks & Reversibility
sections.instruction: Risks acknowledged for each decision, and whether the decision was described as reversible or one-way.

sections.title: Follow-up Actions
sections.instruction: Actions spawned by these decisions, with owners and due dates. Always add reference transcript segment and timestamp.
sections.item_format:
| **Owner** | Action | Due | Reference Transcript Segment | Segment Time stamp |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

sections.title: Deferred / Unresolved
sections.instruction: Questions left open or decisions explicitly postponed, with who owns pulling them forward.
